svg.title: A profile page behind every avatar, name and @mention — SoftTrack web design mockup (#126)
svg.desc: Every person links to a profile page with their title, department, manager, direct reports, location, start date and the teams the viewer shares with them. Your own profile links to Settings → Profile; a deactivated profile still resolves.
svg.text: A profile page behind every avatar, name and @mention
Amina Khan’s profile, as Daniel sees it

g.text: Only teams Daniel shares with Amina.
stranger’s team list says what a team is called and
that it exists, the same reason @mentions resolve
Goes to Settings → Profile, the one
This account was deactivated on 12 Aug 2026. Tickets
Resolves instead of a 404: history keeps

svg.text: People are links wherever they appear

g.text: THE QUICK PEEK ON THE BOARD
Safari drag ghost offset on scrolled columns
Directory rows, comment authors, @mentions and the assignee on
cards and in the peek all open /people/<username>. In the properties
panel the assignee stays a picker.

svg.text: . Teams on it are the intersection with the viewer’s, filtered in the query. Own profile: the same page plus Edit profile. Deactivated: shown as deactivated
rather than 404, because assignments and comments keep pointing at a person.
